verdict.rationale: Several evidence items come from Flagsmith's own GitHub repository (github.com/Flagsmith/flagsmith), and the docs say the complete platform can be self-hosted. That suggests the product's source is publicly readable, but no evidence item states the license or confirms it is an open one. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of an OSI-style open-source license, confirmation that the full platform source (not just SDKs) is public, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Make changes remotely: Easily toggle individual features on and off, and make changes without deploying new code
Self-hosting Flagsmith allows you to run the complete Flagsmith platform within your own infrastructure
